evals.name: should-trigger-handoff-high-context
evals.prompt: Estamos cerca de los 500k de contexto, hagamos el handoff a otra sesión para seguir con la historia.
evals.expected_behavior: Activates session-handoff. Resolves <<PRIMARY_ROOT>> with git rev-parse --git-common-dir, lists <<PRIMARY_ROOT>>/.session/handoffs/ to pick the next NN, walks all ten capture-contract sections (empty ones as an explicit none line), labels claims measured or predicted, marks open PRs / deploys / running work PERISHABLE with the measured time and a re-verify command, writes the file, then launches or prints the successor launch line for the same worktree and harness.

evals.name: should-trigger-continue-in-fresh-session
evals.prompt: Write a handoff so a fresh session can continue this exactly where we stopped; the staging deploy is still building.
evals.expected_behavior: Activates session-handoff. Re-verifies the deployment state before writing §7, records the deployment id and pushed SHA verbatim as PERISHABLE with the poll command from /vercel-cli, and says in §7 that this item comes before the §8 priority list. The successor's first prompt names the handoff by absolute path.

evals.name: should-trigger-handoff-from-worktree
evals.prompt: I'm in a linked worktree. Hand this session over to a new one.
evals.expected_behavior: Activates session-handoff. Writes the file under the PRIMARY checkout's .session/handoffs/ (never the worktree's own .session/), counts NN from that directory, and launches the successor with the worktree root (git rev-parse --show-toplevel) as its working directory, with the harness's own bare binary (no wrapper, no env loader in front of it).

evals.name: should-trigger-without-runtime
evals.prompt: pasa el contexto a otra sesión, no hay ningún orquestador corriendo
evals.expected_behavior: Activates session-handoff on the no-runtime path: writes the file first, then prints one launch line and the handoff path for the owner to paste, with a first prompt byte-identical to the runtime path. The printed instructions do not mention any specific orchestration product.

evals.name: should-not-trigger-delegate-task
evals.prompt: Dispatch a worker to implement UPEX-210 while I keep reviewing the other PR.
evals.expected_behavior: Does NOT activate session-handoff. This is delegating a scoped task while the session continues (orchestration or a briefed subagent per AGENTS.md §3), not transferring the whole session.

evals.name: should-not-trigger-story-resume
evals.prompt: Resume UPEX-145 where the last sprint-development run left it.
evals.expected_behavior: Does NOT activate session-handoff. Routes to /sprint-development Phase 0, which reads .session/sprint-development/UPEX-145/progress.md and offers resume / restart / abort.

evals.name: should-not-trigger-remember-decision
evals.prompt: Remember for next month that we chose RLS over app-level tenancy checks.
evals.expected_behavior: Does NOT activate session-handoff. A durable project decision goes to Engram (mem_save) and, if architectural and hard to reverse, an ADR in .context/ADR/; a handoff is disposable and gitignored.
